// Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-27; see LICENSE and README.md.
// Extracts original expected results, not Pulse or a replacement IP algorithm.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

type row struct {
	Suite    string   `json:"suite"`
	Name     string   `json:"name"`
	Pattern  string   `json:"pattern"`
	Input    []string `json:"input,omitempty"`
	Expected []int    `json:"expected,omitempty"`
	Operator string   `json:"operator,omitempty"`
	Match    bool     `json:"match"`
	Reject   bool     `json:"reject"`
	Start    int      `json:"source_start"`
	End      int      `json:"source_end"`
}

func literal(expr ast.Expr) string {
	if call, ok := expr.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
		expr = call.Args[0] // []byte("...") in operator tables.
	}
	value, err := strconv.Unquote(expr.(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return value
}

func main() {
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, os.Args[1], nil, 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	count := 0
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || (fn.Name.Name != "Test_IPFilter" && fn.Name.Name != "Test_IPLineFilterTy" && fn.Name.Name != "Test_IPLabelFilterTy") {
			continue
		}
		ast.Inspect(fn.Body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
			assign, ok := n.(*ast.AssignStmt)
			if !ok || len(assign.Lhs) != 1 {
				return true
			}
			name, ok := assign.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident)
			if !ok || name.Name != "cases" {
				return true
			}
			for _, entry := range assign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
				item := entry.(*ast.CompositeLit)
				r := row{Suite: fn.Name.Name, Start: fset.Position(item.Pos()).Line, End: fset.Position(item.End()).Line}
				for _, field := range item.Elts {
					kv := field.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
					switch kv.Key.(*ast.Ident).Name {
					case "name":
						r.Name = literal(kv.Value)
					case "pat":
						r.Pattern = literal(kv.Value)
					case "input":
						for _, value := range kv.Value.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
							r.Input = append(r.Input, literal(value))
						}
					case "expected":
						for _, value := range kv.Value.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
							i, err := strconv.Atoi(value.(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
							if err != nil {
								panic(err)
							}
							r.Expected = append(r.Expected, i)
						}
					case "line", "val":
						r.Input = []string{literal(kv.Value)}
					case "expectedMatch":
						r.Match = kv.Value.(*ast.Ident).Name == "true"
					case "fail":
						r.Reject = kv.Value.(*ast.Ident).Name == "true"
					case "ty":
						r.Operator = map[string]string{"LineMatchEqual": "|=", "LineMatchNotEqual": "!=", "LineMatchRegexp": "|~", "LineMatchNotRegexp": "!~", "LabelFilterEqual": "=", "LabelFilterNotEqual": "!="}[kv.Value.(*ast.Ident).Name]
					}
				}
				if err := enc.Encode(r); err != nil {
					panic(err)
				}
				count++
			}
			return false
		})
	}
	if count != 15 {
		panic("unexpected upstream case count")
	}
}
